arcs.title: The Duck Bandit
arcs.summary: Day 2: A copper-green thread, six inches, smelling of pine resin, was found on the Jeep's nearside mirror housing. The Sticking Charm on the fourth duck dates to pre-1980. Steve cross-referenced all household and shed fabrics — no match. The thread is in a jar on the kitchen table. Lucy was observed studying it with notable focus. Day 3 should deepen the pine-resin lead — perhaps a location associated with pine and old charm-work, or Lucy's interest proves meaningful. The hats remain a throughline; the next duck, if one appears, should have a more elaborate one. The Bandit's identity should remain unrevealed but the shape of them should grow slightly clearer.
